investors: Eight Roads Ventures | F-Prime Capital | Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw | Rainmatter by Zerodha | Singularity AMC
summary: Immuneel Therapeutics, a Bengaluru-based biotech startup, raised over Rs 100 crore in a Series B round with participation from Singularity AMC, Rainmatter by Zerodha, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Eight Roads Ventures and F-Prime Capital to expand manufacturing and commercialise its CAR‑T therapy Qartemi across Asia Pacific and the Middle East.
Lumiq, a Noida-based data and AI platform for the BFSI sector, is raising Rs 50 crore (~$5.2 million) in a Series B round led by Bajaj Finserv Ventures with participation from Info Edge.
Innefu Labs raised $30 million in a Series B round led by Panthera Growth Partners to fund global expansion and deep‑tech R&D in AI for national security.

Aadyah Aerospace raised Rs 31.5 crore (about $3.3 million) in a Series A round led by Helios Holdings with participation from angel investor Meenu Sharma to fund a U.S. acquisition and working capital.

The Sweet Change, a natural sweetener startup, raised Rs 1.7 crore in a pre‑seed round led by Rebalance with participation from IAN Angel Fund to expand distribution, launch new products and scale its sugar‑alternative portfolio.

investors: BNP Climate Fund | Goldman Sachs | JM Financial Mutual Fund | Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund | Mirae Asset Mutual Fund | Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund
summary: Ola Electric raised Rs 780 crore ($94 million) through a Qualified Institutional Placement, with participation from several global and domestic institutional investors.
Ride‑hailing platform Rapido raised $240 million in a growth‑stage round led by Prosus.

STCH, a Bengaluru-based textile tech startup, raised $5.5 million in a pre-Series A round led by Omnivore with participation from Kae Capital and WVC to expand its AI-driven fabric R&D and manufacturing platform.

investors: Blume Ventures | Hardik Pandya | Jasprit Bumrah | MIXI | MS Dhoni | Ravindra Jadeja | Sai Sudharsan | Shreyas Iyer | Tilak Varma | Times Internet | V3 Ventures
summary: LightFury Games raised $11 million in a pre-Series A round from investors including Blume, V3 Ventures, MIXI, Times Internet and several Indian cricketers to fund development of its AAA mobile cricket title eCricket.

investors: Blume Ventures | CRED | Peak XV Partners
summary: Consumer AI startup M (Curious Digital Pvt Ltd) raised Rs 102 crore in a Series Seed round led by Peak XV Partners with participation from Blume Ventures and CRED.

TraqCheck, an HR tech startup now based in London, raised $8 million in a Series A round led by IvyCap Ventures with participation from IIFL to expand its AI-driven background screening and sourcing agents in Europe.

Pluckk raised Rs 100 crore in a Series A1 round led by Euro Gulf Investment to expand offline retail, enter international markets, and enhance its AI-driven supply chain, aiming for profitability within a year.
IndiGo Ventures Fund invested about Rs 10 crore in Sarla Aviation, an eVTOL startup, as a minority equity stake to support its operating and expansion needs.
Synthetic biology startup StrainX Bioworks raised $13 million in a growth-stage round co-led by Prime Venture Partners and Leo Capital.
Travel fintech firm Scapia raised $63 million in a growth-stage round led by General Catalyst.
Rapido raised $240 million in a Series F round in May 2026, the largest single funding event in India that month.
Skyroot Aerospace became India's first spacetech unicorn after a $60 million funding round that valued it at about $1.1 billion.
Incuspaze acquired workspace operator iKeva in a 100% buyout to expand its presence in Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
Peak XV Partners sold Go Digit General Insurance shares worth Rs 100 crore in a block deal on the NSE.
Friale Fund IV LLC sold about Rs 210 crore worth of shares in Groww's parent entity in a block deal.
Ixigo approved the acquisition of a 54.66% stake in Brevistay for Rs 65.69 crore and also approved investments in two AI startups.
SoftBank sold shares worth Rs 2,873 crore (about $300 million) in Lenskart through a block deal.
EaseMyTrip reported Q4 FY26 revenue of Rs 152 crore and a net loss of Rs 15.4 crore, with a market cap of about $276 million.
TBO Tek reported Q4 FY26 revenue of Rs 814 crore and profit of Rs 60 crore, showing strong year‑on‑year growth.
The Indian government announced a Rs 10,000 crore Fund of Funds 2.0 to support deep‑tech, manufacturing and early‑growth startups through segmented AIFs.
